create_entry.default: Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and sign in to your school. Devices and entities appear on their own.

hassio_confirm.title: Connect the Ranzenpost app
hassio_confirm.description: The app {addon} was found. Connect Home Assistant to it?

install_addon.title: Install the Ranzenpost app
install_addon.description: The Ranzenpost app is not installed yet. Add the repository {repository}, then install and start the app?

addon_no_discovery.title: The app has not announced itself
addon_no_discovery.description: The app {addon} is installed but has not announced its connection details yet. Open the app, check that it is running, and enter the host, port and token from its Home Assistant settings block.

data_description.host: Host name of the app container, usually shown in its settings.
data_description.port: Port of the integration API, 8099 by default.
data_description.token: Access token shown in the app settings.

manual.title: Connect Ranzenpost manually
manual.description: Enter the host, port and token of the running Ranzenpost container. The token is shown in the Ranzenpost settings.

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the Ranzenpost container.
data_description.port: Port of the integration API, 8099 by default.
data_description.token: Access token shown in the Ranzenpost settings.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the Ranzenpost token
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {host} was rejected. Enter the current token from the Ranzenpost settings.

progress.install_addon: The Ranzenpost app is being installed. This can take a few minutes.
progress.wait_discovery: Waiting for the app to announce its connection details.

error.cannot_connect: The app could not be reached. Check that it is running.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Copy it again from the Ranzenpost settings.
error.unknown: The app answered in an unexpected way.

abort.already_configured: This Ranzenpost app is already connected. Every app host can be connected once.
abort.already_in_progress: A Ranzenpost setup is already in progress.
abort.addon_install_failed: The Ranzenpost app could not be installed. Check the Supervisor log.
abort.addon_start_failed: The Ranzenpost app could not be started. Check the app log.
abort.not_ranzenpost_addon: This discovery message does not belong to the Ranzenpost app.

init.title: Ranzenpost options
init.description: How often the integration asks the app, and which profiles get entities.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two requests to the app, at least 30.
data_description.children: Leave empty to create entities for every profile.

login_needed.title: Sign-in needed for {school}
login_needed.description: Ranzenpost could not sign in to {school} anymore. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar, go to settings, select this school and sign in again.

login_twofactor_setup.title: Two-factor needed for {school}
login_twofactor_setup.description: IServ now requires two-factor for this account at {school}. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and finish the setup.

login_unknown_account.title: Account unknown at {school}
login_unknown_account.description: IServ at {school} no longer knows the saved account name. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and connect the school again.

login_default_password.title: Default password blocked at {school}
login_default_password.description: IServ at {school} does not accept the default password from the internet. Change the password inside the school network or in the browser, then reconnect in Ranzenpost.

login_locked.title: Account locked at {school}
login_locked.description: IServ at {school} has locked the account for now. Do not sign in again, that makes the lock last longer. Wait a while or ask the school, then open Ranzenpost.

login_code_refused.title: Code refused at {school}
login_code_refused.description: IServ at {school} keeps turning down the app's confirmation code. The app's access has to be set up again. Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and set up the school from scratch.

addon_too_old.title: Update the Ranzenpost app
addon_too_old.description: The Ranzenpost app runs version {addon_version}, but this integration ({integration_version}) needs at least {required_version}. In Home Assistant open Settings → Apps, then the App store with the Install app button at the bottom right. Open the menu at the top right, choose Check for updates, then open Ranzenpost and select Update. Devices and entities appear on their own once the app reports its schools again.

app_update_needed.title: Update the Ranzenpost app
app_update_needed.description: The Ranzenpost app runs version {addon_version}, the integration is already at {integration_version}. New functions only work once both have the same version. In Home Assistant open Settings → Apps, then the App store with the Install app button at the bottom right. Open the menu at the top right, choose Check for updates, then open Ranzenpost and select Update. This notice disappears on its own.

integration_too_old.title: Update the Ranzenpost integration
integration_too_old.description: The Ranzenpost app runs version {addon_version}, this integration is still at {integration_version}. Open HACS, open Ranzenpost and install the update. Then restart Home Assistant: Settings → menu at the top right → Restart Home Assistant. Until then some data may be missing. This notice disappears on its own.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish the Ranzenpost update

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The Ranzenpost integration {installed_version} is installed, but Home Assistant still runs {loaded_version}. Confirm this step to restart Home Assistant now. You can also restart later: Settings → menu at the top right → Restart Home Assistant.

no_school_yet.title: No school signed in yet
no_school_yet.description: Open Ranzenpost in the sidebar and sign in to your school. Devices and entities appear on their own.
